question: Can continuous cached quartet evidence improve species branch ranking without re-inference or new quartet scores?
diagnostics: DIAGNOSIS.json: 507 erroneous branches saturate at 100; count pseudovote and vote-gap variants already failed on exposed development.
evidence: Same unique cached quartets, three frozen scores, final classification; fully flat scores excluded identically to baseline.
selection: Choose exactly one candidate by pooled development ROC-AUC, before confirmation inference/evaluation. No parameter or candidate search beyond these four.
confirmation_gate: Frozen winner improves pooled AUC with positive lower 95% stratified tree-bootstrap paired difference, and does not increase errors at the development-fixed high-support cutoff in either family. Also report per-family AUC and high-region coverage.
high_region: For each method choose the largest development set above a score cutoff with >=99% correctness, at least 1000 branches and 20 records represented. Apply that exact cutoff on confirmation; absent qualifying cutoff is a failure, not NA success.
timing: Measure final cached-evidence reduction separately; no new model calls, no new inference rounds. Production integration only after confirmation; otherwise retain prototype and report limitations.
evidence_role: Record/seed-disjoint confirmation for support formula selection within already exposed simulation pools; not a fresh project holdout.
stop: No candidate modifications after confirmation. If no candidate passes, stop and report the next mechanism to investigate.
